about: Every company the pieces name, with the Brandfetch domain its real logo comes from. House rule LOGOS_AND_FACE and VISUAL_EVIDENCE: a visual that names a company shows that company's real logo, from its own brand files, never redrawn.

scripts/post-pack/visual_gate.py reads this list: a name found in the fact-checked body must appear in the logos of at least one packed picture, and on the cover. Add a company here the first time a piece names it; the gate names the ones it cannot find.
A name may have several spellings; the first is how the logo list writes it.
mentions_only_about: Named as a source or a channel, never as a subject: a piece that only cites them needs no logo. A piece about one of them moves it out of this list.
marks_about: The official mark files a render may use (floor never 6: real logos, used with the rights, never redrawn). scripts/post-pack/logo_gate.py hash-matches every logo file a cover, thumbnail or card uses against this list and refuses any file not here. Each entry: {"company": the first name above, "variant": "full_colour" or "one_colour" (the company's own one-colour version), "file": the path in this repository, "sha256": the file's, "source": where it came from (the company's brand page or Brandfetch asset URL, without its per-request token)}. Add one with: python3 scripts/post-pack/logo_gate.py register FILE --company NAME --variant full_colour --source URL. It starts empty: whether the house cream recolours in docs/plans/*/logos count as a one-colour version is Krish's call.
